title: Eng kerakli 30 ta barqaror ibora
goal_uz: Dars oxirida 30 ta eng kerakli barqaror iborani ma’nosiga qarab, to‘g‘ri uslubda va so‘zma-so‘z tarjimasiz ishlatasiz hamda 10 tasidan qisqa dialog tuza olasiz.

scenes.title: 30 ta barqaror ibora
board: Lesson: 30 Essential Expressions
(Eng kerakli barqaror iboralar)
fixed phrases · collocations
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda fe’lning infinitiv va gerund shakllarini o‘rgandik. Bugun nutqingizni jonlantiradigan narsani o‘rganamiz: barqaror iboralar. Ingliz tilida so‘zlar yakka emas, juftlik va guruh bo‘lib yuradi. Bugun o‘ttizta eng kerakli ibora bilan tanishamiz. Dars oxirida ularni mazmuniga qarab, to‘g‘ri uslubda va so‘zma-so‘z tarjimasiz ishlata olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we'll learn thirty essential fixed expressions that make your English sound natural. By the end, you'll know what they mean in context, when to use them, and how to avoid translating word for word.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! Bugun ingliz tilingizni tabiiy qiladigan o‘ttizta barqaror iborani o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida ularning ma’nosini, qachon ishlatilishini bilasiz va so‘zma-so‘z tarjimadan qochasiz.

scenes.title: Barqaror ibora nima?
board: fixed expression = tayyor birikma
collocation = so‘zlarning odatiy juftligi
make a decision ✓ · do a decision ✗

examples.t: I need to make a decision.
Let's take a break.

scenes.say_native: Barqaror ibora yoki kollokatsiya — so‘zlarning tabiiy, odatiy birikmasi. Masalan, “make a decision”, “take a break”. Nega “do a decision” demaymiz? Chunki ingliz tilida shunday qabul qilingan. Bu qoidaga emas, odatga tayanadi. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday: “choy ichmoq”, “qaror qabul qilmoq” deymiz, “qaror olmoq” esa g‘alati eshitiladi. Demak, so‘zlarni yakka emas, juftlik bilan yodlang.
scenes.say: A fixed expression, or collocation, is a natural combination of words. We say make a decision and take a break. We don't say do a decision. There's no deep rule here, it's simply what native speakers say. So learn words in pairs, not alone.
scenes.say_uz: Barqaror ibora yoki kollokatsiya — so‘zlarning tabiiy birikmasi. Make a decision va take a break deymiz, do a decision demaymiz. Bu yerda chuqur qoida yo‘q, shunchaki shunday aytiladi. Shuning uchun so‘zlarni juft-juft yodlang.

scenes.title: So‘zma-so‘z tarjima xavfi
board: ✗ He made a photo.
✓ He took a photo.
Uzbek / Russian ≠ English

examples.t: She took a photo of the bridge.

scenes.say_native: Asosiy tuzoq: so‘zma-so‘z tarjima. O‘zbek tilida “surat olmoq” deymiz, rus tilida “сделать фото”, ya’ni “make”. Natijada “He made a photo” degan xato paydo bo‘ladi. To‘g‘risi “took a photo”. Har bir tilda o‘z birikmalari bor va ular har doim mos kelmaydi. Shuning uchun yangi ibora uchrasa, uni bo‘laklarga ajratib tarjima qilmang, butun holicha ma’nosi bilan eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Word-for-word translation is dangerous. In Russian you can make a photo, but in English you take a photo. Each language has its own combinations. So learn the whole expression, with its meaning, instead of translating it piece by piece.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zma-so‘z tarjima xavfli. Rus tilida suratni make bilan aytish mumkin, ingliz tilida esa take a photo. Har bir tilning o‘z birikmalari bor. Iborani butunligicha yodlang.

scenes.title: Uslub: rasmiy va norasmiy
board: formal: as soon as possible · in my opinion
neutral: by the way · at the moment
informal: no worries · fair enough
scenes.say_native: Iboralar uslubi har xil. Ba’zilari rasmiy, masalan, “in my opinion”, “as soon as possible”. Ba’zilari neytral, ya’ni hamma joyda mos. Ba’zilari norasmiy, do‘stlar orasida: “no worries”, “fair enough”. Direktorga “no worries” deyish biroz erkin eshitilishi mumkin, do‘stga esa “I would be grateful” juda rasmiy chiqadi. Har bir iborada biz uning uslubini ham aytib boramiz, shuning uchun diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Expressions have different registers. Some are formal, such as in my opinion. Some are neutral, such as by the way. Some are informal, such as no worries. Choose the one that fits the person and the situation.
scenes.say_uz: Iboralarning uslubi har xil. Ba’zilari rasmiy, masalan in my opinion. Ba’zilari neytral, masalan by the way. Ba’zilari norasmiy, masalan no worries. Odam va vaziyatga mosini tanlang.

scenes.title: Fikr bildirish: 1–5
board: 1) by the way · 2) to be honest · 3) it depends (on)
4) as far as I know · 5) in my opinion

examples.t: By the way, have you seen Tom?
To be honest, I didn't like the film.
It depends on the weather.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi guruh: suhbat iboralari. “By the way” — aytgancha, mavzuni o‘zgartirish uchun, neytral. “To be honest” — rostini aytsam, ochiq fikr oldidan, norasmiyroq. “It depends” — bog‘liq, ko‘pincha “it depends on” bilan. “As far as I know” — bilishimcha, ishonchim to‘liq emas. “In my opinion” — mening fikrimcha, rasmiyroq. Mana beshta ibora, hozir ularni gapda ko‘rasiz.
scenes.say: Group one: conversation phrases. By the way changes the topic. To be honest introduces a frank opinion. It depends on shows that it isn't simple. As far as I know means I'm not completely sure. In my opinion is a slightly formal way to give your view.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi guruh: suhbat iboralari. By the way mavzuni o‘zgartiradi. To be honest ochiq fikrni boshlaydi. It depends on oddiy javob yo‘qligini bildiradi. As far as I know — to‘liq ishonmasligingiz. In my opinion — fikringizni biroz rasmiyroq bildirish.

scenes.title: According to me emas
board: ✗ According to me, it's a good idea.
✓ In my opinion, it's a good idea.
✓ I think it's a good idea.
scenes.say_native: Mana tipik xato. O‘zbek va rus tilidan “menimcha” ni “according to me” deb tarjima qilamiz. Ingliz tilida “according to” boshqa odamlarning fikrini keltirishda ishlatiladi: “according to the report”, “according to Anna”. O‘z fikringiz uchun “in my opinion” yoki oddiygina “I think” deng. Yana: “it depends of” emas, “it depends on”.
scenes.say: A typical mistake: according to me. We use according to for other people or sources, like according to the report. For your own view, say in my opinion or simply I think. And remember: it depends on, not of.
scenes.say_uz: Tipik xato: according to me. According to boshqa odamlar yoki manbalar uchun ishlatiladi. O‘z fikringiz uchun in my opinion yoki I think deng. It depends on, of emas.

scenes.title: Iborani tanlang
board: 1) ___, I'm a bit tired. Can we go home? (honest)
2) Where is the post office? — ___ it's near the bank.
3) Will you come? — ___ my boss.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Mos iborani tanlang. Birinchi: “Rostini aytsam, charchadim, uyga ketaylikmi?” Ikkinchi: “Pochta qayerda?” — “Bilishimcha, bank yonida.” Uchinchi: “Kelasizmi?” — “Bu rahbarimga bog‘liq.” Har biriga ingliz tilida mos iborani ayting va gapni to‘ldiring.
scenes.say: Which phrase fits? One: I'm a bit tired, so can we go home? Say it honestly. Two: Where is the post office? You think it's near the bank, but you're not sure. Three: Will you come? It depends on your boss.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi ibora mos? Bir: Biroz charchadim, uyga ketaylikmi? Ochiq ayting. Ikki: Pochta qayerda? Bank yonida deb o‘ylaysiz, lekin ishonmaysiz. Uch: Kelasizmi? Bu rahbaringizga bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) To be honest, I'm a bit tired.
2) As far as I know, it's near the bank.
3) It depends on my boss.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “To be honest, I’m a bit tired”. Ikkinchi: “As far as I know, it’s near the bank”, chunki aniq ishonchingiz yo‘q. Uchinchi: “It depends on my boss”. Agar aytgancha demoqchi bo‘lsangiz “by the way” ni boshqa mavzu o‘rtasida, masalan, “By the way, what time is it?” deb ishlating. Bu birinchi besh ibora.
scenes.say: One: To be honest, I'm a bit tired. Two: As far as I know, it's near the bank. Three: It depends on my boss.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: To be honest, I'm a bit tired. Ikki: As far as I know, it's near the bank. Uch: It depends on my boss.

scenes.title: Vaqt iboralari: 6–10
board: 6) as soon as possible (ASAP) · 7) from time to time
8) at the moment · 9) in the end · 10) on time

examples.t: Please reply as soon as possible.
examples.uz: Iltimos, imkon qadar tezroq javob bering.

examples.t: I'm busy at the moment.
The train arrived on time.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh: vaqt iboralari. “As soon as possible”, qisqartmasi ASAP, imkon qadar tezroq. “From time to time” — ba’zan, vaqti-vaqti bilan. “At the moment” — hozir, Britaniyada keng tarqalgan. “In the end” — oxir-oqibat, uzoq jarayondan keyin. “On time” — o‘z vaqtida, aniq jadval bo‘yicha. “In time” esa vaqtida ulgurib, undan oldin degani. Ikkalasining farqini keyingi xatoda ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Group two: time expressions. As soon as possible means very quickly. From time to time means occasionally. At the moment means now. In the end means finally, after a process. On time means punctual, exactly as planned.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi guruh: vaqt iboralari. As soon as possible — juda tez. From time to time — ba’zan. At the moment — hozir. In the end — oxir-oqibat. On time — aniq belgilangan vaqtda.

scenes.title: On time yoki in time, end
board: on time = aniq vaqtida · in time = ulgurib
✗ in the end of the lesson
✓ at the end of the lesson

examples.t: We got to the airport in time to have coffee.
examples.uz: Biz kofe ichishga ulgurib aeroportga yetib keldik.

scenes.say_native: Ikkita chalkashlik. Birinchisi: “on time” aniq belgilangan vaqtda, “in time” esa kechikmasdan, ulgurib. “We arrived in time to have coffee” — kofe ichishga ulgurdik. Ikkinchisi: “in the end” va “at the end of”. “In the end” o‘zi turadi: “In the end we agreed”. Ammo biror narsaning oxiri uchun “at the end of the lesson” deymiz. “In the end of the lesson” — xato.
scenes.say: Two confusions. On time means exactly when planned, in time means early enough. And in the end means finally, but for the end of something, say at the end of: at the end of the lesson, not in the end of the lesson.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki chalkashlik. On time — aniq belgilangan vaqtda, in time — ulgurib. In the end — oxir-oqibat, biror narsaning oxiri uchun at the end of: at the end of the lesson, in the end of emas.

scenes.title: Vaqt iborasini qo‘ying
board: 1) The meeting starts at 9. Don't be late. Be ___.
2) I don't often go out, only ___.
3) We argued for hours, but ___ we agreed.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi: uchrashuv soat to‘qqizda boshlanadi, kechikmang, o‘z vaqtida bo‘ling. Ikkinchi: kamdan-kam chiqaman, faqat vaqti-vaqti bilan. Uchinchi: soatlab bahslashdik, lekin oxir-oqibat kelishdik. Har bir bo‘sh joy uchun mos iborani tanlang va to‘liq gapni baland ovozda ayting. Esda tuting: on time aniq jadvalga, from time to time takrorlanishga tegishli.
scenes.say: Fill in. One: The meeting starts at nine, so don't be late. Two: I don't often go out, only occasionally. Three: We argued for hours, but finally we agreed.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiring. Bir: Uchrashuv to‘qqizda boshlanadi, kechikmang. Ikki: Kamdan-kam chiqaman, faqat ba’zan. Uch: Soatlab bahslashdik, lekin oxir-oqibat kelishdik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Be on time.
2) ... only from time to time.
3) ... but in the end we agreed.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Be on time”. Ikkinchi: “Only from time to time”. Uchinchi: “But in the end we agreed”. Yana ikkita iborani eslatib o‘taman: “as soon as possible” va “at the moment”. Ularni xat va elektron pochtada tez-tez uchratasiz: “Please call me back as soon as possible”, “I’m not available at the moment”.
scenes.say: One: Be on time. Two: Only from time to time. Three: But in the end we agreed. Also remember: Please call me back as soon as possible. I'm not available at the moment.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Be on time. Ikki: Only from time to time. Uch: But in the end we agreed. Yana: Please call me back as soon as possible. I'm not available at the moment.

scenes.title: Make, do, take, have: 11–15
board: 11) make a decision · 12) make an effort
13) do the shopping · 14) take a break
15) have a look

examples.t: You should make an effort.
I do the shopping on Saturdays.
Can I have a look?

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi guruh: eng muhim kollokatsiyalar. “Make a decision” — qaror qabul qilmoq. “Make an effort” — harakat qilmoq. “Do the shopping” — uy uchun xarid qilmoq, kundalik ish. “Take a break” — tanaffus qilmoq. “Have a look” — qarab ko‘rmoq. Fe’llarni “make”, “do”, “take”, “have” tanlash qiyin, shuning uchun har bir juftlikni o‘zicha yodlang. Qoidani ishonchli aytib bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun takrorlash eng yaxshi usul.
scenes.say: Group three: common collocations. Make a decision, make an effort, do the shopping, take a break and have a look. The choice of make, do, take or have has to be learnt with each phrase.
scenes.say_uz: Uchinchi guruh: muhim kollokatsiyalar. Make a decision, make an effort, do the shopping, take a break, have a look. Make, do, take yoki have tanlovi har bir ibora bilan yodlanadi.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri fe’l
board: ✗ do a decision → ✓ make a decision
✗ make the shopping → ✓ do the shopping
✗ make a break → ✓ take a break
scenes.say_native: Bu guruhda eng ko‘p xato noto‘g‘ri fe’l tanlash. O‘zbekcha “qaror qabul qilmoq” — “do a decision” emas, “make a decision”. “Xarid qilmoq” — “do the shopping” yoki “go shopping”, “make shopping” emas. “Tanaffus qilmoq” — “take a break”. Maslahat: xatoni bir marta baland ovozda to‘g‘ri aytib ko‘ring, quloq to‘g‘ri variantga ko‘nikadi. Britaniyada “have a break” ham keng ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: The most common mistake is using the wrong verb. Say make a decision, not do a decision. Say do the shopping or go shopping, not make the shopping. Say take a break, not make a break. Say the correct version aloud a few times.
scenes.say_uz: Eng ko‘p xato — noto‘g‘ri fe’l. Make a decision deng, do a decision demang. Do the shopping yoki go shopping deng. Take a break deng. To‘g‘ri variantni bir necha marta baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Fe’lni tanlang
board: 1) I can't ___ a decision yet.
2) Let's ___ a break. I'm tired.
3) Could I ___ a look at your photos?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joyga make, do, take yoki have ni qo‘ying. Birinchi: men hali qaror qabul qila olmayman. Ikkinchi: keling, tanaffus qilaylik, charchadim. Uchinchi: suratlaringizga qarab ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Gapni to‘liq ayting. Esda tuting: qaror va tanaffus bilan bir xil fe’l kelmaydi, ularni bugun ajratib o‘rgandik.
scenes.say: Choose make, do, take or have. One: I can't, blank, a decision yet. Two: Let's, blank, a break. Three: Could I, blank, a look at your photos?
scenes.say_uz: Make, do, take yoki have ni tanlang. Bir: Hali qaror qabul qila olmayman. Ikki: Tanaffus qilaylik. Uch: Suratlaringizga qarab ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) make
2) take
3) have
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “make a decision”. Ikkinchi: “take a break”. Uchinchi: “have a look”. Yana bir foydali eslatma: Amerika ingliz tilida “take a shower” deyiladi, Britaniyada esa ko‘pincha “have a shower”. Yuvinish haqida gapirganda farqni bilib qo‘ying: ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri, faqat mintaqaga qarab farq qiladi.
scenes.say: One: make a decision. Two: take a break. Three: have a look. In British English we often say have a shower, while Americans say take a shower.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: make a decision. Ikki: take a break. Uch: have a look. Britaniyada ko‘pincha have a shower, Amerikada take a shower deyiladi.

scenes.title: Kundalik hayot: 16–20
board: 16) take care of · 17) catch a cold
18) keep in touch · 19) pay attention to
20) change your mind

examples.t: She takes care of her grandmother.
I caught a cold last week.
Let's keep in touch.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi guruh: kundalik hayot. “Take care of” — qaramoq, g‘amxo‘rlik qilmoq. “Catch a cold” — shamollamoq. “Keep in touch” — aloqada bo‘lmoq. “Pay attention to” — e’tibor bermoq. “Change your mind” — fikrini o‘zgartirmoq. O‘zbekcha “shamollab qoldim” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa “I caught a cold”, ya’ni shamolni tutib oldim. Bu so‘zma-so‘z tarjima ishlamaydigan yaxshi misol.
scenes.say: Group four: daily life. Take care of means look after. Catch a cold means get ill with a cold. Keep in touch means stay in contact. Pay attention to means notice carefully. Change your mind means decide something different.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtinchi guruh: kundalik hayot. Take care of — g‘amxo‘rlik qilmoq. Catch a cold — shamollamoq. Keep in touch — aloqada bo‘lmoq. Pay attention to — e’tibor bermoq. Change your mind — fikrini o‘zgartirmoq.

scenes.title: Take a cold va attention on
board: ✗ I took a cold. → ✓ I caught a cold.
✗ pay attention on → ✓ pay attention to
✗ I changed my opinion → ✓ I changed my mind
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. “Shamolladim” uchun “I took a cold” deymiz, to‘g‘risi “I caught a cold”. “E’tibor bermoq” — “pay attention to”, “on” emas, va undan keyin ot yoki “-ing” keladi: “pay attention to the teacher”. Va “fikrimni o‘zgartirdim” — “I changed my mind”. “Opinion” bu yerda mos emas, chunki fikr bilan qaror haqida gap ketyapti. Bu uchtasini yodlang.
scenes.say: Typical mistakes. I took a cold is wrong, say I caught a cold. Pay attention on is wrong, say pay attention to. And for a change of plan, say I changed my mind, not I changed my opinion.
scenes.say_uz: Tipik xatolar. I took a cold noto‘g‘ri, I caught a cold deng. Pay attention on noto‘g‘ri, pay attention to deng. Rejani o‘zgartirsangiz, I changed my mind deng.

scenes.title: Iborani to‘ldiring
board: 1) You must ___ attention to the road.
2) I ___ a cold after the rain.
3) We moved abroad, but we ___ in touch.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi: yo‘lga e’tibor berishingiz kerak. Ikkinchi: yomg‘irdan keyin shamollab qoldim. Uchinchi: xorijga ko‘chib ketdik, lekin aloqada bo‘lib turibmiz. Har bir bo‘sh joyga mos fe’lni qo‘ying. Uchinchi gapda zamonga ham e’tibor bering, chunki bu fe’l hozirgi zamonda keladi. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Fill in the verb. One: You must, pay, attention to the road. Two: I, catch, a cold after the rain. Three: We moved abroad, but we, keep, in touch.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’lni qo‘ying. Bir: Yo‘lga e’tibor berishingiz kerak. Ikki: Yomg‘irdan keyin shamolladim. Uch: Xorijga ko‘chdik, lekin aloqadamiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) pay
2) caught
3) keep
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “pay attention”. Ikkinchi: “caught”, chunki “catch” noto‘g‘ri fe’l, o‘tgan zamoni “caught”, “catched” emas. Uchinchi: “keep in touch”. Qolgan ikkitasi, “take care of” va “change your mind”, ham juda ko‘p uchraydi. Ularni keyingi dialogda va uy vazifasida ishlating.
scenes.say: One: pay attention. Two: caught, because the past of catch is caught. Three: keep in touch.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: pay attention. Ikki: caught, catch ning o‘tgan zamoni caught. Uch: keep in touch.

scenes.title: Take care of va change your mind
board: take care of + kim/nima
Take care! = Ehtiyot bo‘ling! (xayrlashuv)
change your mind = fikrini o‘zgartirmoq

examples.t: I'll take care of the tickets.
I've changed my mind. I'll stay.

scenes.say_native: Ikki ibora ko‘p ma’noda ishlatiladi. “Take care of” faqat odamga qarash emas, ishni o‘z zimmasiga olish ham: “I’ll take care of the tickets” — chiptalarga men qarayman. Alohida “Take care!” esa xayrlashishda aytiladi, ehtiyot bo‘ling degani. “Change your mind” da “mind” birlikda va egalik bilan: “I changed my mind”, “she changed her mind”.
scenes.say: Take care of can mean look after, or handle a task: I'll take care of the tickets. Take care on its own is a friendly goodbye. And change your mind uses mind in the singular: I've changed my mind.
scenes.say_uz: Take care of g‘amxo‘rlik yoki ishni zimmaga olish bo‘lishi mumkin. Take care yolg‘iz o‘zi samimiy xayrlashuv. Change your mind da mind birlikda: I've changed my mind.

scenes.title: Reaksiya iboralari: 21–25
board: 21) no worries · 22) never mind
23) good for you · 24) what a pity
25) it's up to you

examples.t: Sorry I'm late. — No worries!
What a pity you can't come.
Pizza or pasta? — It's up to you.

scenes.say_native: Beshinchi guruh: reaksiya iboralari. “No worries” — hechqisi yo‘q, norasmiy. “Never mind” — e’tibor bermang, bo‘ldi. “Good for you” — yaxshi bo‘libdi, qoyil, ko‘pincha maqtov. “What a pity” — qanday afsus. “It’s up to you” — sizga bog‘liq, o‘zingiz hal qiling. Eng muhimi, ohangga e’tibor bering: “Good for you” kinoyali ohangda aytilsa, kinoya bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say: Group five: reactions. No worries is an informal way to say it's fine. Never mind means forget it. Good for you shows approval. What a pity expresses sympathy. It's up to you means you decide.
scenes.say_uz: Beshinchi guruh: reaksiyalar. No worries — norasmiy hechqisi yo‘q. Never mind — esdan chiqaring. Good for you — maqtov. What a pity — achinish. It's up to you — o‘zingiz hal qilasiz.

scenes.title: Depends of va don't matter
board: ✗ It depends of you. → ✓ It's up to you.
✗ No problem for me. → ✓ No problem. / No worries.
✗ It doesn't matter for me. → ✓ It doesn't matter to me.
scenes.say_native: Mana xatolar. “Sizga bog‘liq” deyish uchun “It depends of you” demaymiz. “It’s up to you” — to‘g‘ri variant. Yoki “It depends on you”. Ikkinchi: “No problem for me” o‘rniga “No problem” yoki “No worries”. Uchinchi: “Menga farqi yo‘q” — “It doesn’t matter to me”, “for me” emas. Predloglarga e’tibor bering: kichik so‘z, katta farq.
scenes.say: Typical mistakes with prepositions. Not it depends of you, but it's up to you, or it depends on you. And it doesn't matter to me, not for me. Small words make a big difference.
scenes.say_uz: Predloglar bilan xatolar. It depends of you emas, it's up to you yoki it depends on you. It doesn't matter to me, for me emas. Kichik so‘zlar katta farq qiladi.

scenes.title: Qanday javob berasiz?
board: 1) I forgot your book at home. Sorry!
2) Where shall we eat? I don't mind.
3) I passed my driving test!
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Mos reaksiyani ayting. Birinchi: do‘stingiz kitobingizni uyda unutib qoldirdi va kechirim so‘rayapti. Ikkinchi: qayerda ovqatlanamiz, siz esa qayer bo‘lsa ham farqi yo‘q. Uchinchi: do‘stingiz haydovchilik imtihonidan o‘tdi. Har biriga bitta ibora ayting.
scenes.say: React. One: A friend forgot your book and says sorry. Two: Your friend asks where to eat, but you don't mind. Three: Your friend says he passed his driving test.
scenes.say_uz: Reaksiya bildiring. Bir: Do‘stingiz kitobingizni unutib, kechirim so‘rayapti. Ikki: Do‘stingiz qayerda ovqatlanishni so‘rayapti, sizga farqi yo‘q. Uch: Do‘stingiz haydovchilik imtihonidan o‘tdi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) No worries! / Never mind.
2) It's up to you.
3) Good for you! / Well done!
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “No worries” yoki “Never mind”. Ikkinchi: “It’s up to you”. Uchinchi: “Good for you”, yoki “Well done”, bu yaxshiroq, qoyil degani. Eslatma: “What a pity” yomon xabarga aytiladi, masalan, “Oh, what a pity, I hoped you could come”, ya’ni afsus, kelasiz deb umid qilgandim.
scenes.say: One: No worries, or Never mind. Two: It's up to you. Three: Good for you, or Well done. Use What a pity for bad news.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: No worries yoki Never mind. Ikki: It's up to you. Uch: Good for you yoki Well done. Yomon xabarga What a pity deng.

scenes.title: Uslub bilan ishlash
board: Boss: As soon as possible, please.
Friend: ASAP! / No worries!
Email: In my opinion · I'm not available at the moment
scenes.say_native: Bitta iborani turli vaziyatda tekshirib ko‘ramiz. Rahbarga yozsangiz: “I’ll reply as soon as possible”, “In my opinion, we should wait”. Do‘stingizga: “ASAP!”, “No worries!”, “Fair enough”. Qisqartma ASAP xabarlarda uchraydi, lekin rasmiy xatda to‘liq yozing. Har safar o‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu odam bilan qanday gaplashaman?
scenes.say: Check the register each time. To your boss, write I'll reply as soon as possible and In my opinion, we should wait. To a friend, ASAP and No worries are fine. In a formal email, write the full form.
scenes.say_uz: Uslubni har safar tekshiring. Rahbarga I'll reply as soon as possible va In my opinion, we should wait deb yozing. Do‘stga ASAP va No worries mumkin. Rasmiy xatda to‘liq shaklni yozing.

scenes.title: Fikrni bog‘lash: 26–30
board: 26) make sense · 27) on the other hand
28) in fact · 29) after all · 30) at least

examples.t: That doesn't make sense.
It's cheap. On the other hand, it's slow.
It's not perfect, but at least it works.
examples.uz: U mukammal emas, lekin hech bo‘lmasa ishlaydi.

scenes.say_native: Oltinchi guruh: fikrni bog‘lash. “Make sense” — mantiqan to‘g‘ri, ma’noli. “On the other hand” — boshqa tomondan, qarama-qarshi fikr. “In fact” — aslida, aytgancha aniqlash uchun. “After all” — axir, hamma narsadan keyin, ko‘pincha sababni eslatadi. “At least” — hech bo‘lmasa. Bu iboralar nutqingizni yaxlit qiladi: faqat gaplarni yonma-yon qo‘ymaysiz, ularni bog‘laysiz.
scenes.say: Group six: linking ideas. Make sense means it is logical. On the other hand introduces a contrast. In fact adds more precise information. After all reminds us of a reason. At least gives a positive side.
scenes.say_uz: Oltinchi guruh: fikrlarni bog‘lash. Make sense — mantiqli. On the other hand — qarama-qarshilik. In fact — aniqroq ma’lumot. After all — sabab eslatmasi. At least — ijobiy tomon.

scenes.title: At last yoki at least
board: ✗ At last it works. (= nihoyat)
✓ At least it works. (= hech bo‘lmasa)
at last = nihoyat · at least = hech bo‘lmasa
scenes.say_native: Chalkash juftlik: “at last” va “at least”. “At last” — nihoyat, uzoq kutishdan keyin: “At last, the bus is here!” “At least” — hech bo‘lmasa, kamida: “At least it’s not raining”. O‘zbek tilida ikkalasi ham “oxiri” va “kamida” bo‘lib aralashib ketishi mumkin.
scenes.say: Don't confuse at last and at least. At last means finally, after waiting: At last, the bus is here! At least means a minimum or a positive side: At least it's not raining.
scenes.say_uz: At last va at least ni chalkashtirmang. At last — nihoyat. At least — hech bo‘lmasa. At last, the bus is here! At least it's not raining.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchi ibora
board: 1) I lost, but ___ I tried my best.
2) The flat is nice. ___, it's expensive.
3) Is it expensive? — No. ___, it's the cheapest in town.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Mos iborani qo‘ying: at least, on the other hand yoki in fact. Birinchi: yutqazdim, lekin hech bo‘lmasa qo‘limdan kelganini qildim. Ikkinchi: kvartira yaxshi, boshqa tomondan qimmat. Uchinchi: qimmatmi? Yo‘q, aslida shahardagi eng arzoni. O‘ylab ko‘ring, qaysi ibora qaysi joyga mos, har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose at least, on the other hand or in fact. One: I lost, but I tried my best. Two: The flat is nice, but it is expensive. Three: Is it expensive? No. It's the cheapest in town.
scenes.say_uz: At least, on the other hand yoki in fact ni tanlang. Bir: Yutqazdim, lekin qo‘limdan kelganini qildim. Ikki: Kvartira yaxshi, lekin qimmat. Uch: Qimmatmi? Yo‘q. Shahardagi eng arzoni.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) at least
2) On the other hand
3) In fact
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “at least”. Ikkinchi: “On the other hand”, chunki fikr qarama-qarshi. Uchinchi: “In fact”, chunki u oldingi gapni aniqlaydi: qimmat emas, aslida eng arzon. Ko‘rdingizmi, iboralarning o‘rni kontekstga bog‘liq. Birinchisida “at least” ijobiy tomonni ko‘rsatadi, ikkinchisida “on the other hand” qarama-qarshilikni.
scenes.say: One: at least. Two: On the other hand. Three: In fact, because it corrects the idea in the question.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: at least. Ikki: On the other hand. Uch: In fact, chunki savoldagi fikrni aniqlaydi.

scenes.title: Dialog: yangi ish
board: Dan: Have you made a decision about the job?
Lena: To be honest, I'm still not sure.
Dan: Take your time. It's up to you.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Dan va Lena yangi ish taklifi haqida gaplashadi. Lena qaror qabul qilishga qiynalyapti. Tinglang: u nima uchun ikkilanyapti va Dan unga nima deydi? Dialogda bugungi iboralardan bir nechtasini topishga harakat qiling. Birinchi tinglashda umumiy mazmunni tushuning, keyin iboralarni ushlang.
scenes.say: Listen. Dan: Have you made a decision about the job? Lena: To be honest, I'm still not sure. The money is good. On the other hand, the office is far away. Dan: It's up to you, but take your time. Lena: Thanks. I'll tell them as soon as possible. At least I have a few days.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Dan: Ish haqida qaror qabul qildingmi? Lena: Rostini aytsam, hali ishonchim komil emas. Maosh yaxshi. Boshqa tomondan, ofis uzoqda. Dan: O‘zingga bog‘liq, lekin shoshilma. Lena: Rahmat. Imkon qadar tezroq aytaman. Hech bo‘lmasa bir necha kunim bor.

scenes.title: Dialogni tushunish
board: 1) What is good about the job?
2) What is the problem?
3) How many expressions from today can you find?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: yangi ishning yaxshi tomoni nima? Ikkinchi: muammo nima? Uchinchi: dialogda bugungi iboralardan nechtasini topdingiz? Kamida beshtasini nomlashga harakat qiling. Dialogni ichingizda yana bir bor eslang, keyin javob bering.
scenes.say: Answer. One: What is good about the job? Two: What is the problem? Three: How many expressions from today can you find in the dialogue?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering. Bir: Ishning yaxshi tomoni nima? Ikki: Muammo nima? Uch: Dialogda bugungi iboralardan nechtasini topdingiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The money is good.
2) The office is far away.
3) made a decision · to be honest · on the other hand · it's up to you · as soon as possible · at least
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: maosh yaxshi, “The money is good”. Ikkinchi: ofis uzoqda, “The office is far away”. Uchinchi: dialogda oltita ibora bor edi: “made a decision”, “to be honest”, “on the other hand”, “it’s up to you”, “as soon as possible” va “at least”. Agar kamida beshtasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, quloqingiz iboralarga ko‘nikyapti.
scenes.say: One: The money is good. Two: The office is far away. Three: Six expressions: made a decision, to be honest, on the other hand, it's up to you, as soon as possible and at least.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Maosh yaxshi. Ikki: Ofis uzoqda. Uch: Oltita ibora: made a decision, to be honest, on the other hand, it's up to you, as soon as possible, at least.

scenes.title: Dialog: do‘stlar
board: Sam: I caught a cold, so I can't come.
Kate: What a pity! Take care of yourself.
Sam: Thanks. Let's keep in touch.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Sem shamollab qolgani uchun kela olmayapti. Keyt unga hamdardlik bildiradi. Tinglang: Keyt unga nima maslahat beradi va nima uchun ular keyinroq uchrashadi? Bu dialogda reaksiya iboralari ko‘p, ohangiga ham quloq soling. Do‘stlar bir-biriga samimiy gapiradi.
scenes.say: Listen. Sam: I caught a cold, so I can't come tonight. Kate: What a pity! Take care of yourself. Sam: Thanks. I'll call you from time to time. Kate: No worries. Never mind the party. Just keep in touch. Sam: I will. Pay attention to your phone on Saturday!
scenes.say_uz: Tinglang. Sam: Shamolladim, shuning uchun bugun kela olmayman. Keyt: Qanday afsus! O‘zingga qara. Sam: Rahmat. Vaqti-vaqti bilan qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Keyt: Hechqisi yo‘q. Bayram haqida o‘ylama. Faqat aloqada bo‘l. Sam: Bo‘laman. Shanba kuni telefoningga e’tibor ber!

scenes.title: Savollar
board: 1) Why can't Sam come?
2) What does Kate say about the party?
3) When should Kate pay attention to her phone?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Sem nima uchun kela olmaydi? Ikkinchi: Keyt bayram haqida nima deydi? Uchinchi: Keyt qachon telefoniga e’tibor berishi kerak? Qisqa javob bering, iboralarni ishlating. Dialogdagi so‘zlarni aynan takrorlashingiz mumkin, bu yaxshi mashq.
scenes.say: Answer. One: Why can't Sam come? Two: What does Kate say about the party? Three: When should Kate pay attention to her phone?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering. Bir: Sem nega kela olmaydi? Ikki: Keyt bayram haqida nima deydi? Uch: Keyt qachon telefoniga e’tibor berishi kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) He caught a cold.
2) Never mind the party.
3) On Saturday.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “He caught a cold”. Ikkinchi: “Never mind the party”, ya’ni bayramni o‘ylama. Uchinchi: “On Saturday”, shanba kuni. Payqadingizmi, “never mind” bu yerda ot bilan ishlatilgan va “o‘ylama, bo‘lmasa ham bo‘ladi” degan ma’noni beradi. Bugungi iboralar real suhbatda mana shunday birin-ketin keladi.
scenes.say: One: He caught a cold. Two: Never mind the party. Three: On Saturday.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: He caught a cold. Ikki: Never mind the party. Uch: Shanba kuni.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ibora bir butun
board: by the way → /baɪ ðə ˈweɪ/
as soon as possible → /əz ˈsuːn əz ˈpɒsɪbl/
at least /ət ˈliːst/ (bog‘lanib)
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz haqida. Iboralar bir butun, uzluksiz nutq oqimi sifatida aytiladi. “By the way” da “the” kuchsiz, “ðə”. “As soon as possible” da “as” kuchsiz, “əz”, urg‘u “soon” va “possible” da. “At least” da “at” kuchsiz “ət”, urg‘u “least” da. Shuning uchun iboralarni so‘zma-so‘z emas, ritm bilan o‘qing: kuchsiz bo‘g‘inlar tez, urg‘uli bo‘g‘inlar uzunroq va kuchliroq. Ritm sizni tabiiyroq qiladi.
scenes.say: Fixed expressions are said as one flowing unit. In by the way, the is weak. In as soon as possible, the stress falls on soon and pos. In at least, the stress is on least. Say the weak words quickly and the stressed words clearly.
scenes.say_uz: Barqaror iboralar bir butun aytiladi. By the way da the kuchsiz. As soon as possible da urg‘u soon va pos da. At least da urg‘u least da. Kuchsiz so‘zlarni tez, urg‘uli so‘zlarni aniq ayting.

scenes.title: Iboralarni qanday yodlash kerak
board: Gap ichida yodlang
Guruhlang: vaqt · fikr · reaksiya
Har kuni 3 ta iborani ishlating
scenes.say_native: Iboralarni qanday yodlash kerak? Birinchi, yakka emas, gap ichida yodlang: “take a break” emas, “Let’s take a break”. Ikkinchi, guruhlarga ajrating: vaqt iboralari, fikr iboralari, reaksiya iboralari. Uchinchi, har kuni uchta iborani haqiqiy hayotda ishlating, hech bo‘lmasa ichingizda yoki ovoz chiqarib. Iboralarni yozib, bir hafta o‘tgach qayta ko‘ring. Shunda ular faol lug‘atingizga aylanadi.
scenes.say: To learn expressions, put them in whole sentences, group them by topic, and use three of them every day. Review them after a week. That's how they move into your active vocabulary.
scenes.say_uz: Iboralarni yodlash uchun to‘liq gaplarda o‘rganing, mavzu bo‘yicha guruhlang va har kuni uchtasini ishlating. Bir haftadan keyin takrorlang. Shunda ular faol lug‘atingizga aylanadi.

scenes.title: Gap tuzing
board: Choose 5 expressions from today
Make one true sentence for each
e.g. I take a break every hour.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizning navbatingiz. Bugungi o‘ttiz ibora ichidan beshtasini tanlang va har biri bilan o‘zingizga tegishli bitta gap ayting. Masalan: “I take a break every hour”, “To be honest, I like winter”. Gaplar haqiqiy bo‘lsin, shunda yaxshiroq yodlanadi. To‘xtang va gapiring.
scenes.say: Your turn. Choose five expressions from today and make one true sentence with each. For example: I take a break every hour. To be honest, I like winter.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. Bugungi iboralardan beshtasini tanlang va har biri bilan haqiqiy gap tuzing. Masalan: I take a break every hour. To be honest, I like winter.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: As far as I know, the shop opens at nine.
I do the shopping on Saturdays.
I'll call you as soon as possible.
At least it's not raining.
scenes.say_native: Mana namunalar. “As far as I know, the shop opens at nine.” “I do the shopping on Saturdays.” “I’ll call you as soon as possible.” “At least it’s not raining.” Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin va bu yaxshi. Tekshiring: fe’l to‘g‘ri tanlanganmi, predlog joyidami, uslub vaziyatga mosmi? Shu uch savol sizni xatolardan saqlaydi.
scenes.say: Here are some models. As far as I know, the shop opens at nine. I do the shopping on Saturdays. I'll call you as soon as possible. At least it's not raining.
scenes.say_uz: Namunalar. As far as I know, the shop opens at nine. I do the shopping on Saturdays. I'll call you as soon as possible. At least it's not raining.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: 30 expressions in 6 groups
collocation: make a decision · take a break
register + no word-for-word translation
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Bugun oltita guruhdagi o‘ttizta iborani o‘rgandik: suhbat iboralari, vaqt iboralari, make, do, take, have kollokatsiyalari, kundalik hayot, reaksiyalar va fikrni bog‘lash iboralari. Asosiy fikrlar: so‘zlarni juft-juft yodlang, so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang, uslubga e’tibor bering va gap ichida mashq qiling. Xatolardan eng muhimlari: “do a decision”, “took a cold”, “according to me”, “in the end of”.
scenes.say: Let's review. We learnt thirty expressions in six groups. Learn words in pairs, don't translate word for word, think about register, and practise in whole sentences. Watch out for do a decision, took a cold and according to me.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa. Oltita guruhdagi o‘ttizta iborani o‘rgandik. So‘zlarni juft yodlang, so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang, uslubga e’tibor bering va gap ichida mashq qiling. Do a decision, took a cold va according to me xatolaridan ehtiyot bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: a short dialogue with 10 expressions
Underline the 10 expressions
Check verb, preposition and register
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bugungi o‘ttiz iboradan o‘ntasini ishlatib, qisqa dialog yozing. Ikki kishi gaplashsin, kamida sakkiz-o‘n qator bo‘lsin. O‘n iborani tagiga chizing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘nta ibora ham to‘g‘ri fe’l va predlog bilan ishlatilgan va dialogning uslubi vaziyatga mos. Keyingi darsda rasmiy va norasmiy xat yozishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to write a short dialogue using ten of today's expressions. Underline them. Check that each one has the correct verb and preposition and that the register fits the situation. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: bugungi iboralardan o‘ntasini ishlatib qisqa dialog yozing. Ularning tagiga chizing. Har bir iborada fe’l va predlog to‘g‘ri, uslub esa vaziyatga mos ekanini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Bugungi 30 ta iboradan 10 tasini ishlatib qisqa dialog yozing (kamida 8 qator). 10 iborani tagiga chizing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir iborada fe’l va predlog to‘g‘ri, uslub vaziyatga mos.

quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida make a decision deyiladi.

options: I took a cold last week.
I caught a cold last week.
I made a cold last week.
I had caught cold last week.

quiz.q: The film starts at 8:00. We arrived at 8:00, exactly as planned. We arrived ___.
quiz.why_uz: Belgilangan vaqtda — on time; in time — ulgurib, kechikmasdan.
It's up to you — o‘zingiz hal qiling.

options: According to me, it's too expensive.
In my opinion, it's too expensive.
By my opinion, it's too expensive.
On my opinion, it's too expensive.
quiz.why_uz: Menimcha — in my opinion yoki I think.

quiz.q: I'm busy ___, can I call you later?
The flat is nice. ___, it's very expensive.
quiz.why_uz: Qarama-qarshi fikr — on the other hand.

quiz.q: It's raining, but ___ we have an umbrella.
quiz.why_uz: Hech bo‘lmasa — at least; at last — nihoyat.

quiz.q: You should pay attention ___ the teacher.

quiz.why_uz: Imkon qadar tezroq — as soon as possible.
